content_data.project_description: Comprehensive workflow optimization program to streamline customer touchpoints across digital and physical channels, enhancing conversion rates and customer lifetime value throughout the European e-commerce market.
content_data.timeline: 18 months with Phase 1 (months 1-6), Phase 2 (months 7-12), and Phase 3 (months 13-18)
objectives: Increase average order value through personalized marketing automation
deliverables: Integrated marketing automation platform deployment across 12 European markets
Automated email and SMS workflow templates for key customer segments
content_data.competitive_analysis: Recent market analysis reveals competitors are investing heavily in personalization technology, with leading e-commerce platforms achieving 28% higher conversion through AI-driven recommendations. Our current fragmented approach across European markets creates inefficiencies that cost approximately 180,000 EUR annually in lost opportunities and duplicated efforts.
